name: visio-image-rebuilder
description: Visio 图重建 Skill (visio-image-rebuilder) — rebuild or restyle editable Microsoft Visio diagrams from reference images and existing .vsdx files, then export deliverables as .vsdx/PNG/SVG/PDF/PPTX. Recreates paper figures and model diagrams as native shapes/text/connectors instead of embedding a flat image, with panel-calibration helpers to avoid drifted or overlapping submodules. Includes a default Chinese technical-bid flowchart mode (SimSun 12pt, fixed style/page box, VSDX-only batch output) and ships PowerShell/COM automation scaffolds plus CJK-safe Unicode-escape guidance.
